raw.title: Remote Financial Services Agent (Independent Contractor) – Inbound Card & Account Support
raw.description:
Set your own hours, take inbound banking card calls from home, and earn up to $350 in certification bonuses. The contract has a pool of 20,000+ hours of work available every month.

Earnings at a Glance

  • $15.00–$17.00 per hour, plus performance incentives

  • $300 certification bonus once you complete 200 productive hours

  • +$50 bonus if you certify within 6 weeks

  • Choose your own hours. Coverage runs 24/7, every day

  • Remote, U.S.-based, 1099 independent contractor

The Opportunity

Help cardholders manage their money with confidence. You'll take inbound calls from people who rely on their cards for everyday life. They might be activating a new card, replacing a lost one, sorting out a disputed charge, or getting a time-sensitive payment through. These moments matter, and you're the person who makes them go smoothly.

What the Work Involves

  • Inbound calls on card activation, replacements, lost or stolen cards, balances, and account questions

  • Payments, transfers, and disputes, handled accurately and securely

  • Identity verification and strict security and compliance protocols on every call

  • Spotting potential fraud and helping resolve it with composure

  • Accurate documentation of every interaction

You're a Fit If You Bring

  • Clear, empathetic phone communication, even when callers are stressed

  • Care for protecting sensitive financial information

  • Comfort moving between multiple systems at once

  • Composure and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong plus: banking, card, financial services, or contact center experience

Your Path to Starting Work

  1. Week 1: Apply. Create your ShyftOff account and apply to the Financial Services campaign.

  2. Weeks 2–3: Screening & credentialing. Federal background check, fingerprinting, drug screening, and credential issuance.

  3. Weeks 4–5: Certification. Simulations and scored mock calls. Standards and examples of required work product are demonstrated.

  4. Week 6: Practice calls & go-live. Show that your work meets the program's accuracy and quality standards, then start choosing open hours.

Screening Cost: Please Read Before Applying

This is a federally backed program, so every contractor must complete third-party credentialing before taking live calls. As an independent contractor, you pay these providers directly:

  • Extensive federal background check

  • Fingerprinting

  • Drug screening

  • YubiKey security device (yours to keep)

Total: $299, paid to third-party providers. It's due only when you move into credentialing, not at sign-up.

What You'll Need

  • Ability to pass federal background, fingerprint, and drug screening

  • A quiet home workspace and reliable high-speed internet

  • Commitment to completing self-paced certification (about 6 weeks)

How to Apply

  1. Create your agent account at https://www.shyftoff.com/agents

  2. Apply to the Financial Services campaign from your dashboard

This is an independent contractor (1099) opportunity. You set your own schedule, work remotely, and provide your own workspace and equipment.

  • Apollo (or equivalent outbound/prospecting platform)

raw.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

raw.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (ES)
raw.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

 

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

 

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

 

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

 

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

 

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

 

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

 

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

 

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. raw.title: Storyteller: Freelance B2B Interviewer and Writer
raw.location: EMEA or APAC time zones only
raw.description:
About the Role

Elite Editing is seeking experienced freelance journalists and content professionals to support our growing customer reference and case study programs. We call this our Storyteller role, and we are specifically looking for experienced professionals based in EMEA and APAC time zones.

Our Storytellers own the storytelling process from interview through finished draft. They lead kickoff calls with our clients and their internal stakeholders, interview their customers and subject matter experts (SMEs), identify the strongest narrative angles within the information they gather, and then write compelling case studies and customer reference stories that adhere to client-specific standards and style guides.

This is more than simply working through a list of prepared questions—or turning a transcript into copy. We need skilled storytellers who listen closely, recognize when an answer deserves further exploration, ask intelligent follow-up questions, identify the details that make a story worth telling, and then shape that material into polished, engaging content.

Our ideal freelancer has a journalism or professional interviewing background paired with extensive professional writing experience and strong editorial judgment. You should be comfortable speaking with senior business leaders, technical SMEs, and other professionals; able to quickly understand unfamiliar or complex subject matter; and skilled at transforming what you learn into a clear and compelling narrative.

What You'll Do

You will:

  • Conduct virtual kickoff calls with client stakeholders to understand the goals, context, audience, and desired direction of customer reference stories.
  • Conduct virtual interviews with our clients' customers and SMEs, often involving senior-level or highly technical professionals.
  • Review project background materials and prepare for interviews in advance.
  • Use provided interview guides as a starting point while adapting questions to the conversation.
  • Ask thoughtful, unscripted follow-up questions that uncover meaningful details, examples, outcomes, challenges, and quotable insights.
  • Identify and develop the strongest story angles from interviews, background materials, and client input.
  • Write polished B2B case studies and customer reference stories based on the information you gather, following client-specific briefs, templates, standards, and style guides.
  • Synthesize complex or technical information into accurate, accessible, and engaging narratives for the intended audience.
  • Maintain a professional, confident, and personable presence while representing Elite and our clients on calls.
  • Work collaboratively with Elite's project managers, editors, and other members of the content team throughout the development and revision process.
  • Follow client-specific processes, confidentiality requirements, and project instructions.

Job Requirements

Successful candidates must:

  • Have substantial professional writing experience, with a portfolio demonstrating the ability to develop clear, engaging, publication-ready content.
  • Have professional experience conducting interviews, preferably in journalism, B2B content, tech, publishing, corporate communications, or a related field.
  • Be located in EMEA or APAC time zones.
  • Have excellent spoken and written English and exceptional verbal communication skills.
  • Be an exceptional listener who can think on their feet and pursue useful lines of questioning in real time.
  • Be comfortable interviewing senior executives, business leaders, customers, and subject matter experts.
  • Be able to absorb unfamiliar information quickly and ask credible, informed questions about complex topics.
  • Have strong editorial judgment and be able to identify the narrative, details, and supporting evidence that will make a compelling story.
  • Be able to synthesize interviews, transcripts, background materials, and client input into a cohesive finished piece.
  • Be highly reliable, organized, responsive, and comfortable working within established processes and deadlines.
  • Have a professional remote-work setup, including reliable high-speed internet and high-quality audio/video capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

We're especially interested in candidates with one or more of the following:

  • A professional journalism background, particularly experience developing reported stories from initial research and interviews through finished copy.
  • Experience interviewing executives and subject matter experts.
  • Experience with B2B technology, enterprise technology, SaaS, cloud computing, professional services, or other complex industries.
  • Experience developing customer stories, customer reference content, case studies, thought leadership, or other long-form B2B content.
  • Experience working with or for a content, marketing, communications, or creative agency.
  • Familiarity with agency workflows in which freelancers work as part of a larger client delivery team.
  • Experience conducting interviews and developing content on behalf of major brands or enterprise organizations.
  • The ability to make interview subjects feel comfortable while keeping conversations focused and productive.

Prior agency experience is helpful but not required. We are much more interested in finding outstanding storytellers with excellent interviewing skills, writing ability, editorial judgment, curiosity, and professionalism.

Freelance Relationship

This is a freelance opportunity rather than a full-time staff position. Work will be offered based on project needs, Storyteller availability, subject-matter fit, and time zone.

Elite manages the broader client relationship, project workflow, and content production process. Freelancers work within established project parameters and compensation structures and collaborate with Elite's internal team and other content professionals to deliver the work.

Because interviews are scheduled with clients and their customers, this work requires the ability to commit to agreed-upon call times and arrive fully prepared.

About Elite Editing

Elite Editing is a woman-owned, fully remote strategic content agency based in Baltimore, Maryland. Founded in 2008, Elite began as an editing company and has grown into a full-service content partner supporting organizations with content strategy, writing, editing, marketing and sales enablement, AI implementation, and program management.

Our clients range from small businesses, publishers, agencies, universities, and thought leaders to some of the world's leading enterprise organizations. Our global network of writers, editors, interviewers, project managers, and other content professionals helps clients create high-quality content at scale.

Elite's approach is highly collaborative. We build specialized teams around our clients and integrate our processes with theirs, supporting everything from kickoff and research through SME interviewing, writing, editing, and final delivery.

We're serious about quality, but we're equally serious about being good people to work with. Our culture emphasizes trust, adaptability, collaboration, high standards, and finding a way to say "yes" to challenging work.

Who We'd Love to Hear From

You may be an especially strong fit if you've spent part of your career as a journalist and have since moved into freelance B2B, corporate, or branded content—or if you continue to work in journalism while taking on select commercial assignments.

If you know how to interview people well, recognize the story hiding within a conversation, and turn that raw material into compelling finished content, we'd like to hear from you.

raw.description:
TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of more than one million contributors from diverse backgrounds who help customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and contribute to the development of innovative AI technologies used by some of the world's largest brands.

We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

Qualification path

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

raw.title: Head of Engineering
raw.description:
About Lemon.io

Lemon.io is a profitable, growing talent marketplace that connects vetted senior engineers with companies that need them. We’ve been in business for 10 years, have 60 people across Ukraine, Europe, Canada, and the US, and process over $16M in annual GMV. We compress the traditional 2–5 week hiring timeline down to 24–48 hours through a curated, pre-vetted supply of developers.

Hiring is still broken. Recruiters spend weeks building candidate pipelines on traditional platforms, burning energy on unqualified leads. We’re building the product that changes that. Giving recruiters qualified, vetted candidates within 24 hours without the grind. This is a pivotal moment: we’re transitioning from a services-driven marketplace to a technology-driven platform. We need an engineering leader who can drive that transformation.

The Role

You will own engineering at Lemon.io. You’ll lead a growing team of engineers, make critical architecture and prioritization decisions, and be directly accountable for the speed and quality of what we ship. This is not a management-layer role. You’ll be hands-on, deeply involved in product decisions, and working side by side with the founder.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the technical roadmap and make sure every engineering effort maps directly to business impact. No features for features’ sake.
  • Lead and grow an engineering team that ships fast, iterates constantly, and treats complexity as a cost.
  • Tackle the hard, multi-layered problem: automated vetting, intelligent matching at scale, demand-side bottlenecks. And figure out where the real leverage is.
  • Make hard prioritization calls. Decide what we build, what we skip, and what we kill.
  • Work directly with the founder and product team to define what success looks like before writing a single line of code.
  • Build the engineering culture: high ownership, high speed, low bureaucracy.

Who You Are:

  • Product-minded, business-first
  • Obsessed with simplicity
  • First principles thinker
  • Fast. Bias toward action

Experience:

  • You’ve led engineering teams (5–30+ people) at a startup or high-growth company.
  • You have hands-on experience with modern stacks and are comfortable with AI/ML tooling.
  • You’ve worked in a distributed, async-first team.

Why Lemon.io:

  • Profitable and growing. No fundraising pressure, real business fundamentals.
  • A pivotal moment: you’re not maintaining an engine, you’re building one. The product roadmap is wide open.
  • Direct access to the founder. No layers. Your decisions ship.
  • A massive, unsolved problem: hiring is still broken. We’re building the product that makes it radically faster for companies to find qualified engineers.
  • A team of 60 people who move fast, care deeply, and have survived the hard years together.

We are seeking a motivated and dedicated Phone Sales Agent to join our Restock team. In this role, you’ll reach out to loyal customers who are running low on the products they already know and love, and help them reorder before they run out.

These are warm conversations with people who have already bought from us and already like what we sell. You’re not cold calling. You’re the person who calls at exactly the right moment, makes reordering easy, and keeps their routine uninterrupted. This is a base pay + commission position with uncapped earning potential, making it perfect for individuals who thrive in a performance-driven environment.

What You’ll Do:

  • Call, text, and email existing customers whose supply is running low, and secure the reorder before they run out.

  • Work an assigned queue of reorder opportunities daily, following the established call and follow-up cadence.

  • Review each customer’s purchase history and order details before you dial, so every conversation is accurate and personalized.

  • Recommend the right product and the right quantity based on where the customer is in their routine.

  • Introduce complementary products that pair well with what the customer already uses, and grow the value of every order.

  • Follow up persistently and professionally across phone, SMS, and email to keep customers engaged and drive conversion.

  • Build rapport with repeat customers so they look forward to hearing from you.

  • Maintain accurate records of every customer interaction and sales activity in our CRM.

  • Meet or exceed individual sales targets on a weekly and monthly basis.

What You Bring to The Table:

  • Strong work ethic and self-motivation to drive sales results.

  • Comfort and proficiency with manual dialing and reaching out to leads.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to engage customers via phone, email, and text.

  • Comfort working inside a CRM and order management system, with strong attention to detail on customer records.

  • A consultative approach, with the instinct to listen first and sell second.

  • A positive attitude and a passion for sales.

  • Ability to work independently and handle rejection with resilience.

  • Ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

  • Prior experience in phone sales or telemarketing is a plus, but not required.

Technical Must Have’s:

  • We require a stable internet connection (50+mbps Up & down)capable of supporting seamless voice and zoom communications, and data transfer, with an Octane Speed of 20,000 or greater (https://chromium.github.io/octane/).

  • A backup system for power and internet.

  • A fast and reliable laptop or desktop computer, with working camera, and a working noise-cancelling headset. You will be on Zoom with your team throughout the day.

Compensation:

  • Base pay

  • 4+% commission on sales revenue (minus refunds). Your commission rate tiers up as you hit higher performance levels, so top producers earn a higher percentage on the same revenue.

  • Uncapped earning potential

  • Weekly and monthly performance bonuses, including top average order value, top weekly sales, QA excellence, and perfect attendance.

Schedule:

  • Full time (35-45 hrs per week)

  • Schedules vary between 9:00am and 7:00pm CT

  • Must be available to work weekends

Department

Outbound Sales

Locations

Multiple locations

Remote status

Fully Remote

raw.title: Appointment Setting Representative
raw.description:
Join the Frontline of Health Innovation at Sun Coast Sciences

At Sun Coast Sciences, we’re on a mission to help people feel, think, and live better — through science. As an Appointment Setting Representative, you’ll be the first point of contact for individuals exploring our wellness solutions. Your voice will spark interest, build trust, and set the stage for impactful conversations with our senior sales team.

If you’re proactive, personable, and excited about connecting people to life-changing skin care solutions, this is the role for you.

 

 

What You'll Do

  • Make First Contact: Reach out to prospective customers with curiosity and care, introducing them to Sun Coast Sciences’ science-backed products.
     

  • Set the Table for Sales: Schedule qualified appointments for our senior closers — every conversation you set in motion helps someone on their journey to better skin and health.
     

  • Collaborate & Refine: Work closely with sales leadership to maximize conversion rates and improve outreach strategy.

 

 

The Perks

  • Hourly Pay + Performance Incentives
    Competitive base pay plus bonus opportunities based on booked and completed appointments.
     

  • Work from Anywhere
    Fully remote role with a consistent, full-time schedule. All you need is a reliable setup and a passion for helping people.
     

  • Growth-Focused Culture
    Join a lean, driven team that celebrates high standards, innovation, and continuous improvement.
     

 

Who We’re In Search Of

  • A knack for persuasive communication and unwavering determination to reach key decision-makers
     

  • Ability to manage a fluid calendar and prioritize tasks to maximize productivity and efficiency
     

  • Ambitious self-starters, passionate about personal development and driven by the prospect of career advancement
     

  • Fluent in English with superb verbal and written communication skills, building rapport naturally and authentically
     

  • Technical aptitude, with a reliable internet connection exceeding an Octane Speed of 20,000 to ensure smooth operations
     

  • Availability of backup power solutions to mitigate potential disruptions
     

  • A private workspace equipped with a high-performing computer, quality microphone, webcam, and noise cancelling headset to facilitate clear communication


Compensation:

  • Base pay plus commission with uncapped earnings potential.

 

Schedule:

  • 9am-5:30pm CT, Tuesday and Wednesday off

  • 9am-5:30pm CT, Sunday & Monday Off

  • 9am-5:30pm CT, Friday & Saturday Off

Room to Grow

  • High-performing Appointment Setters may be considered for:

    • Senior Setter roles

    • Team Lead Roles

    • Closer training tracks

    • Increased commission opportunities

raw.title: Protocol Review Specialist
raw.description:
Transform Lives. Earn Unlimited. Work Remote.

As a Protocol Review Specialist, you'll conduct 20-minute consultative appointments with customers who've purchased our skin care and wellness products. Your mission? Guide them through personalized protocols that optimize their results, and their lives.

The Role:

You'll walk customers step-by-step through science-backed wellness protocols tailored to the products they've purchased. Using our proven permission-based selling approach, you'll identify when customers could benefit from additional supplements, products, or devices to support their beauty goals.

This process generates a sale on 30%-40% of the appointments, with an average order value somewhere around 2X what the customer spent online. So reps can sell anywhere from $500 to $1,000 every day, depending on their skill level and commitment to excellence.

Our Protocol Review Specialists enjoy a calendar full of scheduled appointments, a beautifully designed and lightning fast CRM and Phone System, and the fulfilling work of helping people live their healthiest life.

If any or all of this resonates with you, and you want to join our rapidly growing and THRIVING team of Protocol Review Specialists, we want to meet you.

What We're Looking For:

Non-Negotiables:

  • Genuine passion for skincare, health and wellness - you'll live and breathe this topic daily

  • Fluent English speaker - exceptional verbal and written communication skills are essential

  • Commitment to full-time work - 40 hours/week, usually Monday-Friday 9am-5:30pm CST with weekend appointments for added earning potential

  • Commission-driven mindset - motivated by performance-based unlimited earning potential

Technical Requirements:

  • Stable high speed internet (40 Mbps+ upload and 40 Mbps+ download required https://www.speedtest.net/)

  • Processing power and internet stability (Octane Speed 20,000+: https://chromium.github.io/octane/)

  • Backup system for power/internet outages (i.e. dedicated hotspot and power bank to last the entire day)

  • Reliable computer with working mic, camera, and noise-cancelling headset (Zoom-ready)

Ideal Candidate:

  • Self-starter who thrives on growth and sales excellence

  • Background in skincare/health/wellness or sales is a plus, but hunger to learn matters most

  • Natural relationship-builder who connects authentically with customers

  • Embodies integrity, drive, and Sun Coast Sciences’ core values

Compensation - Pay vs Draw:

  • Hourly draw or 15% commissions on Net Sales (Gross Sales minus Refunds)

  • You earn whichever is greater: draw or commission

Schedule

  • Typically Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:30 PM CST

  • Additional weekend appointments are available to increase earning potential


Ready to turn your wellness passion into serious income?

If you're driven to help customers transform their appearance while building an unlimited income remotely, we want to meet you.
Pay versus draw compensation model to help you ramp up

Apply today and join our rapidly growing team of top performers.

raw.title: Quality Assurance Rater - Spanish (Spain)
raw.description:
Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies.

This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems.

A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater

In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality.

Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on.

You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies.

You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines.

Key Responsibilities

  • Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness.
  • Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions.
  • Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards.
  • Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues.
  • Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required.
  • Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews.
  • Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work.

The hourly earnings for this role are 18 EUR per hour, payment is based on completed tasks.

TELUS Digital AI Community

Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world’s largest brands. 

Qualification path

Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring.

Basic Requirements

  • Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Spanish & English.
  • Resident in Spain for the last 5 consecutive years.
  • Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills.
  • Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools.
  • Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer.
  • Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification
  • Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently.
  • High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification.
  • Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems.
  • Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering.
  • Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements.

Equal Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants’ qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

In this role, you will be reviewing online advertisements by rating them on their relevance to the search terms used, as well as providing feedback on their language and cultural relevance in order to improve their content, quality, and layout

Service Rates

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. Assessment

raw.location: Internationally located (not in the US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)
raw.description:
About Clipboard

Our mission is to uplift as many communities as possible. We do this through our app-based marketplace that connects healthcare professionals with the workplaces that need amazing workers. This enables hundreds of thousands of people to achieve financial stability for themselves and their families while providing essential care to millions of people across the U.S.


Founded in 2016, we are a remote-first team of over 1,000 people building a top Y-Combinator company and have been profitable since 2022. We’re the leader in Long-Term Care staffing and are rapidly expanding into Home Health, Hospitals, and more, meaning we have more work to do than people to do it, and are growing our team to support millions more people and their communities.

About the Role

The Account Manager will be instrumental in helping grow and retain Clipboard's existing markets. Healthcare providers are core to the Clipboard marketplace — the Account Manager is in charge of nurturing and expanding relationships with current users, going deep with those users to understand their needs, and ensuring they're consistently successful on the platform. There's no ceiling to what you can achieve in this role — if you're highly motivated to go above and beyond, a diligent executor, and a strong written/verbal communicator, Clipboard is the place for you to excel.

Responsibilities

  • Managing and growing relationships with an existing portfolio of healthcare providers and dental offices

  • Clearly articulating the value proposition of the app to current users to drive continued engagement and expansion

  • Going deep with healthcare providers and dental offices to uncover their evolving needs, understand their challenges, and find ways to genuinely help them succeed on the platform

  • Establishing credibility and rapport with providers, which includes demonstrating a strong understanding of the app

  • Being the go-to point of contact for users that need help navigating the app, resolving issues, and getting the most out of the platform

  • Helping fill new and urgent shifts in your assigned markets

Qualifications

  • Willingness to hustle / lack of fear

  • Experience texting, emailing, and talking with English-speaking clients and prospects

Requirements

  • Stable high-speed internet connection

  • A computer workstation (laptop or desktop)

  • Internationally located (not in US, CA, UK, NZ, or AU)

  • Availability to work US working hours

  • Fluency in English speaking and writing

Beyond the Basics — What Will Make You Successful

  • Noticing & Curiosity — You pick up on things others miss and ask "why" more than once because the first answer is rarely the whole story. You dig to understand the root of a problem or situation rather than accepting things at face value, and you're constantly updating your understanding of the customers you serve.

  • Initiative & Persistence — You have a bias for action. You know that our customers are dealing with real problems today, and you don't wait for perfect information before making a move. You're scrappy and self-reliant, you find ways through obstacles rather than around them, and you bring solutions instead of asking "what should I do?"

  • Ownership — The buck stops with you, no matter what anyone else did or did not do. You take full responsibility for your results, fix problems when you see them — even outside your immediate area — and put processes in place to make sure those problems don't happen again.

  • Customer-Centric — You feel your customers' situations genuinely and care about improving their lives, not just hitting a number. Talking to customers and solving their problems isn't a task on your list — it's the job.

  • Humble — You're low ego and care about getting to the best outcome, not about being right. You readily admit when you don't know something, you actively seek out feedback, and you're always looking to become a better version of yourself.

Benefits

  • Do great work that matters for customers who could really use your help

  • Competitive pay

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Fully Remote

Estimated annual compensation: $12,000–$15,600 USD. Each candidate's compensation offer within this range will be based on multiple factors including, but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, and geographic location.

raw.description:
We are looking for an independent, flexible, remote opportunity where you can help improve AI-powered search technology from the comfort of your home? If you're curious, internet-savvy, and enjoy evaluating online content, this freelance project could be a great fit.

 

A Day in the Life of a Content Reviewer - US

In this role, you will analyze and provide feedback on text, webpages, images, and other types of online content for leading search engines using a specialized online platform.

 

By reviewing and rating search results for relevance and quality, you will help improve the overall search experience for millions of users around the world, including yourself.

Join our global community and put your skills to work supporting one of the world's leading search technologies.

 

Service Rates 

The rate of pay is $0.2333 per completed task, with an estimated earning potential of $14 per hour. Compensation is based on tasks completed and project availability. Estimated earnings may vary depending on task volume and program requirements including, quality, and productivity, in accordance with the program's quality standards and guidelines.

 

Please note that only one member per household may participate in this program. If it is identified that more than one person from the same household is participating in the TELUS Digital Rating Program, all associated accounts may be removed from the program.

 

Independent Contractor Relationship

This opportunity is offered on an independent contractor basis. Contributors have the flexibility to choose when and how much they work, subject to project availability and quality requirements. This opportunity is not and should not be construed as creating an employment relationship with TELUS Digital.

 

Qualification Process

No previous professional experience is required to apply for this opportunity. However, participation in this project requires meeting the basic requirements and successfully completing the qualification process.

 

Basic Requirements

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• Must have resided in the United States for the past three consecutive years

• Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs in the United States

• Active use of Gmail and social media platforms

• Experience using web browsers to navigate and interact with a variety of online content

• Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection

• Access to a smartphone (Android 5.0 or higher, or iOS 14 or higher)

• Access to a personal computer

 

Assessment

You must complete an English language assessment, pass an open book qualification exam, and complete an ID verification in order to be successful for this role. These assessments will determine your suitability for the position.

Android & iOS Testers Wanted | Help Improve Digital Experiences

Your smartphone. Your experience. Your feedback.

Tester Work is a global QA crowdsourcing platform connecting companies with people around the world to test digital products in real-world conditions.

We’re currently looking for Android and iOS users based in Australia and New Zealand to join our testing community and participate in ongoing, project-based testing opportunities.

This is a flexible opportunity to use your everyday mobile experience to test digital products, identify issues, and provide feedback, while earning money for completed testing tasks.

What You’ll Do

  • Follow step-by-step test cases and validate user flows

  • Test mobile applications on your own Android or iOS device

  • Explore features and identify bugs or usability issues

  • Compare actual results with expected behaviour

  • Submit clear and detailed feedback

  • Provide screenshots or recordings when required

  • Complete surveys or usability feedback tasks

  • Test features and functionality relevant to your local market

Who We’re Looking For

  • Currently based in Australia or New Zealand

  • Have access to a compatible Android smartphone or iPhone

  • Meet the local eligibility requirements for the project

  • Comfortable using mobile apps and websites

  • Detail-oriented and able to follow instructions carefully

  • QA or testing experience is welcome, but not required

What You Can Expect

  • Fully remote work

  • Flexible, project-based opportunities

  • Android and iOS testing projects starting from August 2026

  • Potential for ongoing testing opportunities

  • No previous QA experience required

Why Join Tester Work? Test apps. Find issues. Share your experience. Get paid.

You’ll have the opportunity to test digital products across different industries, build practical QA experience, and provide feedback that helps companies create better digital experiences for users across Australia, New Zealand, and beyond.

If you’re an Android or iOS user in Australia or New Zealand and enjoy exploring how apps work, we’d love to hear from you!
